Current assessment — 2026-10-05

Reviewed against local main 7057a8d5a2d898c1bfb528a28f3f635dda639b8b, origin/main 568ce108 (local main clean, 112 ahead/0 behind at audit; no push).

Where we are: PauleMandel and ModifiedKnappHartung now exist in GroupWeighting/GroupGlm/GroupEngine and current group suites pass (75 JVM/74 JS). The September missing-method inventory is obsolete; generic REML/robust/multicontrast expansion remains deferred, with first-level uncertainty/calibration limits intact.

Fresh context: Yes: deferred extensions; baseline corrected.

Next action: Re-inventory only the remaining estimator/response-family extensions for a concrete consumer, preserving variance/covariance/df identity and independent oracle plus inference qualification. Do not reimplement the delivered PM/mKH baseline.

Evidence: modules/group/.../Group{Weighting,Glm,Engine}.scala; docs/verification/consolidation-20261005.md.

This is a tracker/source/retained-evidence assessment, not a new experiment or test run. Existing acceptance criteria and owner decisions remain binding; dated source-state statements below are superseded where this assessment explicitly corrects them. Status, priority, assignee, claims and dependency edges are unchanged.

---

Previous scope and history (acceptance retained)

Extend the existing typed GroupModel/GroupEngine surface toward fmrireg parity: FE, DL, PM/REML, robust Huber meta-analysis, contrast meta-analysis, covariance output, combination tests, and voxelwise covariates.

Acceptance: group estimators are modeled as typed strategies with exhaustive dispatch; variance requirements remain compile-time visible where possible; tests cover fmrireg meta kernels, heterogeneity diagnostics, covariance payloads, and first-level-to-group workflows.

Sequential assessment 2026-09-12 (supersedes the current-main assumption in earlier notes): GroupWeighting.scala currently has Unweighted, InverseVariance and RandomEffects; TauEstimator has only DerSimonianLaird. GroupEngine dispatches only DL, with GroupStatistic.Normal for weighted fits. No PauleMandel/KnappHartung/mKH implementation was found in current group sources, and docs/verification/group-repair-2026-09-08.md is absent. Thus earlier PM/mKH implementation/qualification notes describe another source state, not verified current-main capabilities. Do not erase those historical receipts or treat their calibration failures as resolved.

Retain P3 for further estimator/response-family expansion. First inventory the actual supported public APIs and recover/requalify any PM/mKH candidate under the separate P1 inference-admission work bd-01M20TKX7VYFT3BHCM7QAMA6NG. Do not count PM/mKH as implemented on main or duplicate its recovery inside a new REML/robust catalogue. Current FE/DL and GroupCovariance already cover parts of the original broad request; remaining REML, robust Huber, correlated multicontrast/combination tests and voxelwise covariates need separately stated estimands and acceptance before implementation.

For each future extension, name the public consumer and method, required within-subject variances/covariances, coefficient/sample identity, failure policy and independent oracle. Keep formula parity separate from inference calibration; estimated first-level uncertainty and covariance-dependent multicontrast tests cannot borrow an unrelated scalar-method admission. No new method, compatibility default or full group qualification is claimed by this assessment.
